articles.title: RTX Secures $104M ESSM Deal, Strengthens Global Missile Leadership
articles.mainIdea: RTX Secures $104M ESSM Deal, Strengthens Global Missile Leadership
articles.summary: Zacks: RTX Secures $104M ESSM Deal, Strengthens Global Missile Leadership. RTX lands a $104.1 million Navy-backed ESSM support contract through 2026, spanning allied partners as Raytheon sustains demand for its proven missile. Related tickers mentioned: BA, LMT, RTX.

articles.title: Boeing’s $724 Million Radar Plane Lives On, Despite Pentagon Efforts to Kill It
articles.mainIdea: Boeing’s $724 Million Radar Plane Lives On, Despite Pentagon Efforts to Kill It
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: Boeing’s $724 Million Radar Plane Lives On, Despite Pentagon Efforts to Kill It. The U.S. Air Force’s E-7 Wedgetail jet program ​seemed doomed by delays and rising costs—until Congress stepped in.
